subject: PREDECLARED gate for arm AE, the housekeeping-band no-impact stop. Written before the run reports.
change: solution/kaggle/cell8/no_impact_band.py alone, on the byte-identical D-undo bundle. Host learns the HUD/moves strip online (rows/cols changing on >=90% of the last 20 presses, 8 warm-ups), labels each executed press gameplay_changed / no_impact, and STOPS a multi-action batch at the first no-impact press (stop_reason='no_impact_action'), prepending a [NO-IMPACT] line to stdout so the model sees it.
offline_validation: solution/sim/test_no_impact_band.py, 5 checks on the shipped bytes, PASS.
evidence_it_rests_on: generated/budget-death-corroboration-2026-09-05.json: 25 deaths in 31 runs, 84% with a consumed edge strip, 76% >= 3rd action into a blind turn
generated/rank4-ablations-verified-2026-09-05.json: same mechanism was rank 4's one clear win, 1.62 vs 1.05 ex-ft09, 21 vs 15 levels, on Qwen3.6-27B in this harness (single 2-pass pair)

primary_mechanism_counters (from ~/work/: M1 deaths per game-run: control 25/31 = 0.81. PASS if arm <= 0.55 (a third fewer). This is the mechanism.
M2 share of deaths with a consumed edge strip: control 84%. Should FALL if the stop is doing its job.

M3 no_impact stops fired per game-run (grep stop_reason=no_impact_action in the events): must be > 0 on the games that have a bar (tn36, sp80, tu93, vc33, lf52, ls20 per the miner's band census) and ~0 on games without one. If it fires on band-less games it is a false-positive machine and the arm is REJECTED regardless of levels.
M4 actions per game-run: expect FEWER (the stop truncates batches). Not a pass/fail on its own.
gate.level_rule: pass-matched and pooled vs control-p2-50play via adjudicate_bench.py. REJECT if pooled <= 55 or paired |up-dn| >= 11 against the arm. TIE (inside |up-dn| <= 8) with M1 and M3 passing => promote to the rotation on rule 15(b) economics (a verified mechanism repair clears the 21% prior). Only a pooled total >= 90 would be called a bench WIN outright.
gate.kill: M3 fires on band-less games, OR M1 does not fall, OR pooled <= 55.

what_would_make_me_wrong: The stop could truncate batches the model NEEDED to complete (e.g. a 10-press traverse where press 3 legitimately changes nothing on the play area). rank 4's equal-action-budget comparison suggests the savings outweigh that, but on our stack it is unmeasured until this run reports.
